design_philosophy: Anti-AI slop: Fusion of Heavy Industrial Command Console (Plancia di Comando) with Holographic Telemetry and Ambient Intelligence. Zero traditional dropdowns or tabular menus. Single continuous vertical-scroll architecture with 3 integrated zones (Master, Floor Operators, BakoMix AI). Master-centric voice-first governance with anti-fooling gates and EU/DE compliance state beacons.

rules: NO default Inter or Roboto for headings. Display headers MUST use Orbitron or Rajdhani with uppercase tracking.
Data metrics (kg, °C, % humidity, timers, PIN codes) MUST use JetBrains Mono in fluorescent cyan or state color.
Persian/Arabic text automatically uses Vazirmatn font-family with proper RTL alignment.
Strictly prohibited: #7351B7 or generic purple gradients on white backgrounds.
Background is always solid deep industrial charcoal/void black (#070A10).
Color is functional: Red = ArbZG/DGUV non-compliance / urgent fault; Amber = warning / fermentation buffer; Green = ready / scale verified; Cyan = live telemetry & active AI state.

zones.title: ZONA 1: MASTER / CAPO LABORATORIO (Plancia di Governo)
zones.description: Top section dedicated to Master governance. Recipe archive, warehouse stock, backwards scheduler, Extra Orders AI, production PIN, live Plant Radar, and EU/DE ArbZG/DGUV/GDPR compliance beacon.

zones.title: ZONA 2: OPERATORI DI BANCO & PIANO PRODUZIONE (Mohamed Floor)
zones.description: Middle section for floor workers. Smart scale assistant, team task queue, dough timers, voice-print liveness gate, optical cross-check photos, headset audio stream.

zones.title: ZONA 3: BAKOMIX AI PRESENCE & GOVERNANCE
zones.description: Integrated bottom section with always-present ambient AI, SOS assistance, dictation to task queue, and multi-language live translation.

instructions_to_main_agent: Rebuild the frontend UI as a Zero-Menu Single-Screen Vertical Scroll Industrial PWA.
Do NOT use traditional navigation tabs or dropdown menus. Implement 3 seamless vertical zones (Master, Floor Operators, BakoMix AI).
BakoMix AI must be fused natively into the background visual canvas with ambient glowing rings, audio wave visualization, and voice reactivity.
Ensure ArbZG/DGUV/GDPR compliance indicators have fluorescent beacon states (Green/Amber/Red) visible across all zones.
Integrate the 'Cerca la tua lingua' selector natively with holographic styling for IT, DE, EN, ES, FR, AR, TR, FA.
Ensure every interactive element includes a valid data-testid attribute.

UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.anti_slop_rule: Avoid generic centered white layouts, soft purple gradients, or Inter font headings. Always use industrial dark command console theme with cyan scanline overlays and JetBrains Mono data readouts.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.data_testid_rule: MUST add data-testid to every button, card, input, and state beacon.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.contrast_rule: Ensure all text on dark surfaces meets minimum 4.5:1 APCA contrast ratio.
